column1: # Comment and blank lines are inert: the parser keys on field 1 via `cut -f1 | grep -qx`,
# which no gate name can match on a "#"-prefixed or empty line (verified empirically).
# Every row below is a gate NAMED in the governance corpus that is NOT yet implemented in an
# executable gate site. Per §11.4.227(A) silent gate debt is forbidden, and per §11.4 a gate
# invented so it cannot FAIL would itself be the bluff - so each is registered as owed debt
# against a tracked item in docs/owed_gate_implementations.md, never faked and never deleted.
#   OWED-GATE-NNN    a real gate whose harness is genuinely owed (58 rows)
#   OWED-NAMING-NNN  a token-extraction ARTIFACT, not a real gate name (8 rows) - deferred
#                    rather than removed because gate_ledger_removals.tsv provably cannot
#                    cover a token that is still PRESENT in the corpus (removals are only
#                    consulted in check-mode for names ABSENT from the ledger).

asserts each badge value traces to a machine-derived provenance source and is never hand-typed; blocked: requires a per-badge provenance computer wired to build, test, coverage and security sources that do not yet exist
asserts the badge computer passes golden-good, golden-bad and negative-control fixtures per 11.4.107(10); blocked: depends on the badge computer landing first

asserts regression localisation used bisection from the last known-good tag with a monotone-observable precheck rather than blame-log walking; blocked: needs a per-investigation evidence record format, none adopted yet

asserts each service asserts env, config, dependency, credential, schema and host invariants at boot and exits non-zero rather than serving; blocked: this repo ships no services, so it needs a consumer service inventory as DATA

asserts no undeclared build inputs - every dependency version-pinned and lockfile-hashed, no unpinned network reach, no host-env leakage; blocked: requires a sandboxed no-network build harness that does not exist here

asserts two independent builds of identical source yield byte-identical artifacts or a diff-set fully accounted for by declared non-determinisms; blocked: requires building real artifacts twice on conformant hosts - this repo has no build pipeline

asserts deploy is blocked unless the provider-by-consumer compatibility matrix is all-green, with a missing contract treated as a first-class refusal; blocked: requires a contract broker holding deployed-version state
asserts the capability matrix declares boot invariants plus offered and required capabilities and stays fingerprint-fresh; blocked: needs a service inventory and an emitted-endpoint extractor
asserts behaviour-changing edits to legacy code are preceded by a landed green characterization baseline; blocked: needs a legacy-classification rule and a baseline-precedence record

asserts every closed item Status matches its Type - Bug to Fixed, Feature to Implemented, Task to Completed; blocked: the Issues/Fixed tracker DATA is consumer-owned and absent from this project-agnostic repo

asserts a failing validation yields a clear per-check report and a documented remediation path, never an opaque hung or rejected push; blocked: the consumer binds its own commit/push script path as DATA per 11.4.35
asserts each changed cross-boundary carries consumer-published and provider-verified contract tests on both sides; blocked: requires a contract broker and a boundary inventory

asserts a stack of two or more compensating heuristics triggers a primitive systematic-debug instead of adding layer N+1; blocked: needs a tower detector that distinguishes accreted mitigation from deliberate defense-in-depth
asserts core.hooksPath does not gate routine commit/push while the hook file itself stays preserved and unmodified; blocked: the consumer binds its repo and hook paths as DATA
asserts simultaneous-retry, mid-operation-crash and retry-after-apparent-success chaos cases all pass; blocked: requires a live database plus a fault-injection harness

asserts each load-bearing invariant lands at the strongest rung the toolchain supports - types over API-shape over lint over property-test over runtime-assert; blocked: needs per-language toolchain capability detection and a rung classifier

asserts a boundary move leaves zero residual references across all seven layers or an explicit tracked compatibility window per residual; blocked: requires the consumer layer-taxonomy audit script and a layer inventory

asserts producer-versus-gate separation is enforced by capability - filesystem scope, branch protection, store isolation - never by prompt or policy text; blocked: requires CI permission-model introspection
asserts every works, passes or verified claim cites machine-created evidence by path, sha256 and timestamp; blocked: requires a content-addressed evidence store
asserts a manual QA pass discovered zero previously-unknown defects; blocked: requires a discovery-channel ledger recording each defect's origin channel
asserts no two near-identical trees exist differing only by configuration values; blocked: requires a cross-tree similarity analyzer plus consumer-owned threshold DATA
asserts every check a disconnected hook performed still executes at a named script stage or release gate; blocked: needs the consumer-owned stage list and deferral registry
asserts no PASS rests on prose, operator eyeballing or an absence-of-error observation; blocked: requires the evidence store to mechanically distinguish narrative from artifact
